# SwissLuxury

> > SwissLuxury is a Miami-based authorized dealer offering luxury Swiss watches from prestigious brands including Bell & Ross, Baume & Mercier, Breguet, and Blancpain at discount prices.

SwissLuxury specializes in authentic Swiss timepieces featuring automatic movements, COSC-certified chronometers, and dive watches. The retailer offers collections ranging from Bell & Ross's aviation-inspired BR 03A and BR-X5 series to Baume & Mercier's elegant Clifton and Riviera lines, all with competitive pricing on steel, titanium, and precious metal cases.

## Key Topics

- Bell & Ross
- Baume & Mercier
- Breguet
- Blancpain
- COSC certified chronometers
- Automatic movements (BR-CAL.302-1, BR-CAL.323, Baumatic BM13-1975A)
- BR-X5 collection
- BR 03A Diver series
- Clifton collection
- Classima collection
- Riviera collection
- Discount luxury watches
- Swiss dive watches
- Steel and titanium cases
- Super-LumiNova
